start.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
start.text: Greetings, Mekatilili. As elder and medicine keeper of our sacred Kaya, I have watched the colonial collectors encroaching upon Ulungu. The ancestors whisper of dark trials ahead.

node_warning.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
node_warning.text: They are watching you closely. Commissioner Champion's spies report every word spoken in the market.

choices.text: Let them watch. The Giriama have nothing to hide when defending their own soil.
We must move quietly until the people are united.

node_arrest_threat.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
node_arrest_threat.text: They may arrest you, Mekatilili. They have chains, and prisons far to the west.

node_counsel.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
node_counsel.text: Silence will not save us now. The colonial decree demands our submission within days.

node_ready.speaker: Mekatilili wa Menza
node_ready.text: Then we must be ready! If they come for one, they must face all of us. Wanje, sound the council call. Let the sacred fire be lit in the village center!

node_pledge.speaker: Wanje wa Mwadorikola
node_pledge.text: It shall be done. The Kifudu dance will begin tonight. Go to the central council fire, Mekatilili; the whole village is gathering to hear you speak!

events.value: Wanje wa Mwadorikola has pledged his full spiritual support to organize the Kifudu gathering and resist colonial recruitment.
